text:
Samir: Quick sync — we need a 45m design review to finalize API error semantics, SDK retry/backoff defaults, and Console validation flows. Pre-read is at https://redwood-internal/docs/sdk-api-errorflow (short RFC + screenshots). Who can do Wed 9:30am PT or Thu 10am PT? Trying to get a final sign-off before the canary next week.

Maya: Thu 10am PT works for me. I can cover Console validation patterns. :+1:

Alex: I can present the SDK retry/backoff options (exponential vs jittered), Thu 10 works. Will add a short sample matrix.

Jordan: Thurs ok but prefer 45m slot starting 10:15 if others can't. Also can we add one slide about canary rollback signal & metrics? I want to make sure we have a clear fail-open vs fail-closed decision.

Lee: Pre-read checklist (please add to the doc):
```
- Link to RFC + one-paragraph summary
- Key API error shapes and examples
- SDK default config + rationale
- Console validation wireframes + touch points
- Canary signal list (latency, 5xx, degraded tokens)
- Owner for follow-ups + rollouts
```
I'll paste this in the doc in a minute.

Priya: I can take notes and create the follow-up task list. Do we want this recorded? If yes I'll set the recording and attach to the notes. Also, can somebody add a short list of APIs that will change (so we can update changelog)?

deploy-bot: Reminder: RFC doc updated by Samir at 2025-11-02 15:12 UTC.

Samir: OK locking Thu 10:00 — calendar invite going out to the channel. Agenda: 1) quick pre-read highlights (5m), 2) SDK retry options (10m), 3) API error shapes & Console UX (15m), 4) Canary + rollback plan (10m), 5) action items (5m).

Samir: Action items before Thu EOD: everyone add any open questions to the "open Qs" section of the doc; Alex and Maya please add your short slides; Lee please finalize the checklist. Priya will record + notes. Thanks! :rocket:

Maya: Added Console screenshots and a short note on required validation messages.

Alex: Slide deck uploaded to the doc. Also adding a sample payload for SDK backoff config:
```json
{"backoff": {"strategy": "exponential_jitter", "base_ms": 100, "max_ms": 5000}}
```

Jordan: Added canary metrics list under the doc section. All set from my side.

Priya: Recording enabled and invite includes Google Meet link. See calendar event.

Samir: Great — see you all Thu. If anything comes up ping me or drop in the doc. :wave:
